summary: Skiff, a six-track groovebox firmware forked from Felucca, with a deep step sequencer, a shared pattern pool, song lists and a live performance layer. Also runs on the SMK-37 Pro keyboard.
features: 14 synth and drum engines, 148 factory sounds browsable by type
64-step sequencer: 4-note chords, overlapping notes, ratchets, trig conditions, p-locks
64-pattern pool, per-track lists of 16 entries, chains and 16 scenes
Up to 16 voices on two CPU cores; screen shows each control's job
USB MIDI out of everything played, clock, MIDI learn; USB audio input
Loads Felucca sounds and projects; 4 projects, 3 user sample slots
